title: Drive the two non-terminal global items to terminal state
description: WHY: two real work items remain non-terminal after the epic closed and are not dependencies of the milestone: bw_work_caa619f2ed9b24e7 (Make strict doctor and sync refresh concurrency safe for gates) is verified but never closed, and bw_work_cd28d24ebd9a785b is needs_verification. Both concern closeout and gate reliability, so they belong to this hardening sprint's theme. WHAT: for the verified item, review its verification evidence and close it with a proper summary, or reopen it if the verification no longer reflects reality after the refactor commits. For the needs_verification item, inspect its attached evidence, run whatever validation its acceptance criteria name, and either verify with a passed verdict and close, or record a failed verification and return it to the queue with a note describing the gap. Do not force anything - if either item cannot honestly reach terminal state, leave it open with an evidence note and report why in the sprint closeout.
acceptanceCriteria: Both items are closed, cancelled or verified-and-closed with honest evidence, or an evidence note explains why they remain open
Commit checkpoint SHA recorded or an accepted no-change reason if the work was tracker-only
closedReason: both referenced global items are terminal
